svg.text: B1 · Dropped garage · clean stair return
GARAGE 8 m CLEAR · CLEAN LOBBY 4 m ABOVE
Garage remains 408 m² in its V8 footprint, with floor at -9.80 m and 8 m clear height. It is 4
m below the clean B1 lobby (-5.80 m). Garage → wash → gowning → full 24-riser transfer stair →
main-stair lobby. A different 8 × 8 m stair descends directly to B2 dirty arrival and decon.
Freight has one garage stop, at -9.80 m, with no redundant lobby-level stop. The boarded 280
m² wing shares the garage floor but has a 4 m ceiling and unused overhead void.
Concept gameplay plan · Door swings / stair treads symbolic · Dimensions govern · Not a construction plan
